KNumber of mobile users (MUs)

\DeltaFrame duration
\mathcal{E}UAV’s energy budget

E^{m}Total energy consumption in mobile execution
E_{k}^{m}Energy consumption of MU k in mobile execution
E_{k,n}^{c}Computation energy consumption at cloudlet for MU k at the nth frame
E_{O,k,n}^{d}Transmission energy consumption for communication between MU k and cloudlet at the nth frame in orthogonal access (d = m for uplink, d = c for downlink)
E_{N,k,n}^{d}Transmission energy consumption for communication between MU k and cloudlet at the nth frame in non-orthogonal access (d = m for uplink, d = c for downlink)
E_{F,n}^{c}Flying energy consumption of the nth frame
L_{k,n}^{d}Number of bits transmitted for communication between MU k and cloudlet at the nth frame (d = m for uplink, d = c for downlink)
l_{k,n}Number of bits computed for application of MU k at cloudlet in nth frame
f_{k}^{m}CPU frequency of MU k
f_{n}^{c}CPU frequency of cloudlet at the nth frame
BBandwidth
N_{0}Noise spectrum density
\gamma_{k}^{m}Effective switched capacitance of MU k's processor
\gamma^{c}Effective switched capacitance of cloudlet processor
MUAV’s gross mass
gGravitational acceleration
